name: revoice
description: Select text anywhere on macOS, hit a hotkey, get it rewritten in your own voice — via Claude Code, Codex (GPT-6 Astra), any OpenAI-compatible API (Kimi), or a local Ollama model, with a rewrite prompt you fully control.

scripts.check: node --check bin/revoice.js && luac -p hammerspoon/revoice.lua && bash -n install.sh
